_note: Shared source of truth for upcoming videos. Videos are produced LOCALLY (Remotion pipeline on Fiker's Mac) and delivered to iCloud — the cloud routine cannot see those files, so it reads this schedule to know what is going out and writes the captions for it. Fiker uploads the video himself; the routine never posts video.
_prep_rule: The Social Team routine (Mon/Wed/Fri) preps a video's caption on the run immediately BEFORE its post date (today < date <= next run day). So a video dated Wed is captioned on Mon's run, Fri on Wed's run, Mon on Fri's run. Keep the next 2-3 rendered videos in 'upcoming' so the routine can always see the one coming up.
_maintained_by: Updated locally whenever a batch is rendered. Keep 2-3 videos in 'upcoming'; move each to 'posted' after it goes out.

upcoming.title: Most people are using AI like a jet engine as a fan
upcoming.hook: A JET ENGINE USED AS A FAN
upcoming.idea: You ask AI a question, it answers, you copy the answer somewhere else. That is the smallest version of what it does. The shift now is AI that runs the whole workflow — reads the email, decides what it is, routes it, drafts the reply, books the follow-up. You just approve. Same technology, completely different leverage.

posted.title: You don't have an AI problem. You have six tabs.
Your AI isn't underperforming. Nobody gave it a job.
